title: Five constituencies. Twenty-five wards. One county.
intro: As Woman Representative, Joyce represents all of Bomet County in the National Assembly. Here is the county she serves, in official numbers.

ngaaf.title: What a Woman Rep does for Bomet
ngaaf.body: The Woman Representative sits in the National Assembly for the whole county and oversees the National Government Affirmative Action Fund (NGAAF) in Bomet — grants to women's, youth and disability groups, and support for vulnerable households.

page.title: {name}
